scripts.build:test: mkdir -p build_test && sass src/style.scss build_test/style.css --no-source-map && cp src/index.html build_test/ && esbuild src/main.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=build_test/main.js
scripts.build:dev: mkdir -p build && sass src/style.scss build/style.css --no-source-map && cp src/index.html build/ && esbuild src/main.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=build/main.js
scripts.start: mkdir -p dev && cp src/index.html dev/ && concurrently --names "SASS,JS,SRV" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,green" "sass --watch src/style.scss:dev/style.css" "esbuild src/main.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dev/main.js --watch" "browser-sync start --server dev --watch --files 'dev/**/*'"
scripts.build: npm test && npm run test:e2e && sass src/style.scss build/style.css --style=compressed --no-source-map && cp src/index.html build/ && esbuild src/main.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=build/main.js && javascript-obfuscator build/main.js --output build/main.js
